WITH finish_times AS (
    SELECT 
        time,
        position
    FROM results 
    WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2008 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix') 
      AND time IS NOT NULL
),
champion AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 10) AS INTEGER) / 1000 AS champion_time
    FROM finish_times 
    WHERE position = 1
),
last_driver AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 10) AS INTEGER) / 1000 AS last_driver_time
    FROM finish_times 
    WHERE position = (SELECT MAX(position) FROM finish_times)
)
SELECT 
    ((last_driver_time - (SELECT champion_time FROM champion)) / last_driver_time) * 100 AS speed_increase_percentage
FROM last_driver
WHERE last_driver_time > 0;	----- bird -----	formula_1
